programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: A ruthless former comrade is back and on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross augments the team with new recruits, leading to a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: An enthusiastic adventurer treks into the Amazon Rainforest, but what begins as a dream experience quickly deteriorates into a nightmare.

programme.title: Boiling Point
programme.desc: Jimmy Mercer is a cop on the edge. He has seven days before he’s transferred - and seven days to wreak revenge on the scum that killed his partner.

programme.title: The Last Gunfight
programme.desc: In a ruthless underground tournament, the world's top assassins fight to the death. However, amongst them is a rogue crew with their own lethal agenda.

programme.title: The Death and Life of Bobby Z
programme.desc: An incarcerated former Marine gets a chance to earn his freedom. All he needs to do is impersonate a recently deceased drug kingpin.

programme.title: Love Lies Bleeding
programme.desc: Reclusive gym manager Lou falls hard for Jackie, an ambitious bodybuilder. But their love ignites violence, pulling them deep into the web of Lou's criminal family.

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Two brothers grow up to be very different people - one a business owner and one a petty mobster. When one brother is kidnapped and held for a ransom, the other must risk everything to save him.

programme.title: Blood Father
programme.desc: An ex-con is thrust back into a life of violence when his estranged daughter bursts back into his life, with a ruthless gang in close pursuit.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Journalist Eddie Brock develops superhuman strength and power when his body merges with an alien symbiote. Twisted, dark, and fuelled by rage, the creature tries to control the new and dangerous abilities that Eddie finds so intoxicating.

programme.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
programme.desc: When a deranged killer also becomes host to an alien symbiote, Eddie Brock and Venom must put aside their differences to stop his reign of terror.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: After the death of his fiancee at the hands of terrorists, Mitch Rapp is drawn into the world of counterterrorism, mentored by a tough-as-nails former Navy S.E.A.L. Stan Hurley.

programme.title: A Warrior's Heart
programme.desc: After his father's death, high school lacrosse star Conor becomes angry and destructive, but a new love interest and a wilderness training camp help him rediscover the warrior within.

programme.title: Catwoman
programme.desc: In Gotham City, a mild-mannered graphic designer stumbles upon a dark secret. Transformed into Catwoman, with the strength, speed and ultra-keen sense of a cat, she becomes a fearless vigilante.

programme.title: Get the Gringo
programme.desc: A career criminal is nabbed by Mexican authorities and placed in a tough prison. There, he learns to survive with the help of a young boy.

programme.title: DarkGame
programme.desc: A determined detective races to stop a twisted game show on the dark web, where captives are forced to compete for their lives.

programme.title: Three Kings
programme.desc: At the end of the Gulf War, a small band of American soldiers seek adventure and fortune by attempting to steal a huge cache of gold hidden somewhere in the desert.

programme.title: RED 2
programme.desc: Retired black-ops CIA agent Frank Moses reunites his unlikely team of elite operatives once again - this time for a globe-trotting mission tracking down a missing portable nuclear device.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: After being betrayed and left for dead in Italy, a thief and his crew travel to L.A. with a plan to steal back their fortune and bring down their double-crossing former ally.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit
programme.desc: A CIA recruit is caught in a dangerous web of intrigue and espionage as he fights to stop a devastating plot against the United States.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Thrilled by his experience with the Avengers, Peter returns home, where he lives with his Aunt May. Under the watchful eye of his new mentor Tony Stark, he begins to navigate his life as high-school teen and secret super-hero.

programme.title: Prisoner of War
programme.desc: During WWII, British RAF Wing Commander James Wright is caught and imprisoned in a Japanese internment camp. Wright must not only survive, but also fight in brutal martial arts matches organized by his captors for their entertainment.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: An enthusiastic adventurer treks into the Amazon Rainforest, but what begins as a dream experience quickly deteriorates into a nightmare.

programme.title: Brothers in Arms
programme.desc: Cal is a by-the-book police officer and Marine Corps reservist. When his reckless younger brother is arrested, Cal must decide how far he'll go to fight for his family.

programme.title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de Guerre
programme.desc: Super spy Orson Fortune and his team of operatives must recruit a Hollywood star to help them on a globe-trotting undercover mission to prevent the sale of a deadly new weapons technology.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: A dangerous storm forces Pilot Brodie Torrance to land his plane on a war-torn island. When his passengers are taken hostage, the only person Brodie can rely on is an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Hot shot fighter pilot Maverick is out to become the best of the best in the Navy's elite Top Gun school. But as a talented yet reckless flyer he's got a lot to learn.

programme.title: Act of Valour
programme.desc: An elite team of Navy SEALs embark on a covert mission to recover a kidnapped CIA agent from a lethal terrorist cell. Filmed using a cast of real-life active-duty US Navy SEALs.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood
programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John Rambo is forced to flee into the mountains surrounding a small town by a tyrannical sheriff and his deputies, where he must wage a one-man war against his pursuers using his combat skills to survive.

programme.title: A Clear Shot
programme.desc: An electronic store erupts into chaos when four gunmen storm the premises, taking shoppers and employees hostage. Sacramento PD's top negotiator is brought in to resolve the situation and prevent a tragedy. Based on real events.

programme.title: Dirty
programme.desc: Over the course of one day, a gangbanger-turned-cop is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue.

programme.title: 21 Bridges
programme.desc: An embattled NYPD detective joins a citywide manhunt for two young cop killers. He convinces the authorities to lockdown Manhattan, closing all 21 bridges, tunnels, and access points to prevent the suspects from escaping.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is offered a prison pardon in exchange for accepting a covert mission to the last place on Earth he'd want to return - the jungles of Vietnam.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Rambo mounts a one-man mission to rescue his friend Colonel Trautman from the invading Soviet forces in Afghanistan.

programme.title: Long Gone Heroes
programme.desc: An ex-special forces soldier is forced back into the field to save his niece, who has been kidnapped in South America. As the fight intensifies, he and his team discover that her disappearance is part of a something much bigger.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
programme.desc: Even your friendly neighborhood superhero can use a vacation. But a new threat forces Peter Parker to swing into action during a school trip to Europe.

programme.title: Sniper: No Nation
programme.desc: Disavowed by the U.S. government, Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero launch an impossible rescue mission when their friends are taken hostage.

programme.title: Bad Man
programme.desc: After a drug-related murder shakes his small town, Deputy Sam Evans finds himself working with undercover agent Bobby Gaines, a hotshot narcotics officer who doesn't play by the rules.

programme.title: Border Hunters
programme.desc: Former spy Abraham Woodhill enlists an imprisoned ex-operative for a high-stakes mission that takes him through Mexico's jungles, villages, and cartel strongholds.

programme.title: Apocalypto
programme.desc: Set against the turbulent end times of ancient Mayan civilisation, a young man is captured for ritual sacrifice and must make a desperate bid to escape his fate and get back to the family he loves. Contains English Subtitles.

programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: A notorious group of criminals baffle police by pulling off elaborate heists. But on their biggest job yet - with $20 million at stake - their plans are interrupted by a hard-boiled detective hell-bent on solving the case.

programme.title: A Working Man
programme.desc: Levon Cade leaves a career in black ops to live a simple life, but his quiet world is interrupted when his boss's daughter is kidnapped. His search to bring her home uncovers a world of corruption.

programme.title: Cult Killer
programme.desc: A private investigator is forced into a dangerous alliance with a killer to uncover a town's grisly secrets and bring justice to its victims.

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: After carrying out an assassination in the Democratic of the Congo, an ex-mercenary has a hit placed on him eight years later.

programme.title: Relentless
programme.desc: A destitute man breaks into the home of an elite cybersecurity expert, igniting a tense game of cat-and-mouse that spirals into blood-spattered chaos - but it'll take an unhinged level of brutality to reveal his true motive.

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programme.desc: With his secret exposed, Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange to make the world forget. But when the spell goes wrong and unleashes dangerous foes from other worlds, Peter is forced to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.

programme.title: The Grey
programme.desc: When their plane crashes in the Alaskan wilderness, John Ottway must lead his team of oil-rig roughnecks through the icy elements as a pack of hungry wolves haunts their every step.

programme.title: RED
programme.desc: Retired black-ops CIA agent Frank Moses is living a quiet life alone - until the day a hit squad shows up to kill him. Frank must reunite his old team in a last-ditch effort to survive, and find out who wants him dead.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: Kyle Reese is sent back to 1984 to protect Sarah Connor. But when the timeline fractures, Reese is thrust into a new and unfamiliar version of the past.

programme.title: Escape From New York
programme.desc: In a dystopian 1997, Manhattan has been turned into a brutal maximum security prison. When the U.S. President's plane is hijacked and crashes onto the island, it’s up to hard-bitten ex-soldier Snake Plissken to rescue him.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: The aging patriarch of a New York crime family transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son, Michael Corleone, pulling him into the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal.

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
programme.desc: Competing for control of the French Riviera, a high class con man and a low brow swindler decide to settle their rivalry with a bet - who can scam a young American heiress out of $50,000 first.

programme.title: Escape From Alcatraz
programme.desc: Three inmates dare to escape from Alcatraz, a maximum security prison on an island situated in the shark-infested waters of San Francisco Bay.

programme.title: The Silent Partner
programme.desc: A bank teller anticipates a robbery and steals most of the cash himself. When the deception is exposed, a chilling game of cat and mouse ensues.

programme.title: The Next Karate Kid
programme.desc: Mr Miyagi takes a new pupil under his wing - a troubled adolescent girl.

programme.title: The Princess Bride
programme.desc: A classic fairy tale, with swordfights, giants, an evil prince, a beautiful princess, a few pirates, and yes, some kissing (as read by a kindly grandfather).

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in America
programme.desc: The story of two boyhood cohorts and their struggle to achieve power in the gangland hierarchy.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: A malevolent force within a supernatural fog traps a remote seaside community. It's seeking revenge against the descendants of the town's founders.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: A salesman must sell 12 cars in two days or lose his job, all while contending with a missing daughter, three women, and a jealous husband.

programme.title: Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A timid shop clerk finds his chance for success and romance with the help of a giant man-eating plant.

programme.title: Men At Work
programme.desc: The lives of two rubbish men are turned upside down when they discover the city commissioner's body in a bin on their route.

programme.title: Alive
programme.desc: Stranded after a plane crash in the snow-swept Andes mountains, members of a Uruguayan rugby team must resort to desperate measures to survive. Based on a harrowing true story.

programme.title: The Godfather, Part II
programme.desc: The history of two generations of crime unfolds. A young Vito Corleone does what he can to survive in Sicily and Hell's Kitchen. In 1950s New York, his son Michael tightens his grip on the family crime syndicate.

programme.title: American History X
programme.desc: A former neo-Nazi skinhead tries to prevent his younger brother from going down the same wrong path that he did.

programme.title: The Negotiator
programme.desc: A top police negotiator framed for embezzlement and murder takes drastic measures to clear his name.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The uniquely macabre Addams Family and their kooky household are surprised by a visit from their long lost Uncle Fester. But is Uncle Fester really everything he seems?

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: A chance meeting with a beguiling woman shatters the dreams of a young baseballer. Sixteen years later, he is given another shot at the big leagues.

The show also introduces viewers to people involved in creating innovations that are based on animals, including biologists who study the behavior of ants, architects designing "living buildings" and roboticists who are making their designs bigger and stronger based on animals.

programme.title: Bill Evans, Chuck Israels & Larry Bunker
programme.sub-title: Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 & '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 & '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history. This collection covers an 11-year span, highlighting Evans' ever-deepening artistry as he performs with four different all-star rhythm sections, including the stunning duo of bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen and drummer Alan Dawson. This recording includes Evans' renditions of the rarely performed “Sareen Jurer,” “Blue Serge”, and “Twelve Tone Tune Two.” Among the many surprises in this collection is a live performance of “My Melancholy Baby” with saxophonist Lee Konitz.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: Gilberto, Gillespie & Skymasters - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, Dutch big band The Skymasters accompanied monumental jazz trumpet legend Dizzy Gillespie and the Brazilian bossa nova singer Astrud Gilberto at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr. combined his singing talent and infectious sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet's music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Jonathon Heyward & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvořák's beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World". Composed during Dvořák's stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions. A deeply expressive and melodic masterpiece, it remains one of the most popular symphonies of all time. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on September 30, 2020.

programme.title: Ballet Jörgen de Canada
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story. Created by acclaimed choreographer Bengt Jörgen, the ballet is set to an original score for orchestra by Russian composer Ivan Barbotin. He previously wrote the scores for two of Canada's Ballet Jörgen's most popular ballets: The Velveteen Rabbit and The Emperor's New Clothes. Anastasia is both the tragic story of an innocent young girl and a modern myth: the exact events of that fateful summer of 1918 are shrouded in the mists of time. The ballet explores this lovable yet controversial main character's emotions, aspirations, and affections, as she is faced with a world in turmoil that undergoes an inevitable transformation. Anastasia is a sumptuous ballet performance, where costume and set design as well as the exquisite stage lighting reveal Canada's Ballet Jörgen's dedication to creative quality.

programme.title: Adele
programme.desc: Fans at the iTunes Festival: London 2011 were blown away with the performance of English singer-songwriter Adele. This concert was recorded live on stage at The Roundhouse in London, United Kingdom, where Adele gave one of the best shows of her career with her unique voice.

programme.title: Willie Nelson
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Michael Bolton
programme.sub-title: Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience. With his inimitable voice, charismatic stage presence and superb songwriting Michael Bolton holds the audience in the palm of his hand as he performs classics such as "How Am I Supposed To Live Without You?", "Time, Love And Tenderness", "Can I Touch You There" and "How Can We Be Lovers" alongside his unique interpretations of "Fly Me To The Moon", "Summertime", "That's Life" and "(Sittin' On) The Dock Of The Bay" plus his own rendition of "Murder My Heart", the hit he co-wrote with Lady Gaga. Simply a wonderful night.

programme.title: The Lumineers
programme.desc: The Lumineers bring energetic American folk-rock to the picturesque Musilac Festival. You won't be able to resist clapping along and stomping your feet to the band's raw sound and enchanting music.

programme.title: Peter Frampton
programme.sub-title: FCA! 35 Tour: An Evening With Peter Frampton
programme.desc: In 2011, Grammy Award winning guitarist Peter Frampton embarked on a world tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of his multi-platinum selling live album "Frampton Comes Alive!". Peter Frampton has chosen what he feels are the best performances of each track for this concert film. He remains one of rock's most iconic guitarists and these live performances catch him at his very best.

programme.title: Jewish Gis
programme.desc: Jewish GIs of WWII tells the profound and unique story of the 550,000 Jewish men and women who served in World War II. Held as POWs and awarded honours for merit and valour, thousands were wounded and 11,000 were killed in action. Ten thousand Jewish women joined up as well, disregarding their parents' warnings that the military 'was no life for a nice Jewish girl'. In the midst of it all, they fought a second, more private battle against anti-Semitism within the ranks. They endured slurs and even violence from their fellow servicemen, and often felt forced to prove their courage and patriotism. Jewish Americans earned their citizenship by shedding blood, leaving their outsider status behind.

programme.title: Lewis & Clark
programme.desc: This four-part documentary series by Ken Burns tells the story of the momentous journey that began in 1804 when Meriwether Lewis and William Clark headed up the Missouri River to explore America's unknown spaces. The series reflects their bond of friendship as well as their vision of the West as it was before the rest of the nation followed them and changed it forever. Extensive use is made of archive material and the stunning cinematography portrays the beauty of the land itself. Part 1 of 4.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: December 1941 to March 1942. The Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor in December 1941 thrusts the United States into the global cataclysm that will eventually touch every family on every street in every town in America. Within a few months, millions of young men have entered the armed forces and are beginning to train for war. A series by Ken Burns. Part 1 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: March 1942 to December 1942. With U-boats menacing the East Coast, and little good news from overseas, many worry that the United States is utterly unprepared to fight in a 'total war'. But after six months of gruelling combat on Guadalcanal, the Americans finally stop Japan's expansion in the Pacific. A series by Ken Burns. Part 2 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: January 1943 to June 1943. American troops land in North Africa and test themselves for the first time against the German and Italian armies, learning to set aside the notion that killing is a sin, and adopting the outlook that 'killing is a craft'. Back home, cities become booming 'war towns' overnight as nearly all manufacturing is converted to the war effort, and thousands of women become industrial workers. A series by Ken Burns. Part 3 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: July 1943 to December 1943. On daylight bombing missions, American airmen gamble with their lives against overwhelming odds to bring the war to the heart of Hitler's vast empire. Allied forces invade Sicily and then Italy but, as they grind their way towards Rome, the weather turns bad and the terrain grows more and more forbidding. Twisting mountain roads and blown bridges have to be negotiated while under constant German fire. A series by Ken Burns. Part 4 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: November 1943 to February 1944. In November, the US marines take the tiny Pacific atoll of Tarawa, but at a terrible cost. Back home, Japanese-Americans are permitted to form a special segregated infantry unit and begin to train for combat. As the war economy booms, ugly racial violence erupts in cities across the country. Overseas, in the mountains south of Rome, the allies try to fight their way around the edges of Monte Cassino, but are stopped cold. A series by Ken Burns. Part 5 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: January 1944 to June 1944. American and British troops are pinned down at Anzio for months, while at Monte Cassino, the killing goes on and on. African-Americans, incensed at the segregation of the armed forces, put pressure on the military to make some changes. In May, allied soldiers at Cassino and Anzio resume their drive northward in Italy, liberating Rome on 4 June, but they let the retreating German army get away. A series by Ken Burns. Part 6 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: 6 June 1944: D-Day. In the early hours of 6 June 1944, the invasion of France begins. A million-and-a-half men take part. It is the bloodiest day in American history since the Civil War, though the Allies succeed in tearing a 45-mile gap in Hitler's vaunted Atlantic Wall. By day's end more than 150,000 men have landed on French soil, and more men, equipment and supplies are coming ashore every hour. A series by Ken Burns. Part 7 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: June 1944 to August 1944. American and British troops in Normandy are bogged down in the hedgerows, while in the Pacific, the marines fight their costliest battle to date on the island of Saipan. Back home, dreaded telegrams from the War Department begin arriving at a rate inconceivable just one year earlier. But by mid-August, the Germans are in full retreat out of France, and on 25 August, after four years of Nazi occupation, Paris is liberated. A series by Ken Burns. Part 8 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Autumn 1944. In September of 1944, with their troops in Europe stalled on the German border having outrun their supply lines, Allied commanders gamble on a risky plan to drop thousands of airborne troops behind enemy lines in Holland. When the mission ends in disaster, it becomes painfully clear that the war in Europe will not end before winter. In the Pacific, on the island of Peleliu, the marines fight one of the most brutal campaigns of the war. A series by Ken Burns. Part 9 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Autumn 1944. In the late autumn of 1944 American soldiers suffer terrible losses when they are ordered into the forbidding and fiercely defended terrain of the H�rtgen Forest and the Vosges Mountains. In the Central Pacific, to the delight of audiences back home, General MacArthur returns to the island of Leyte. But months of bloody fighting lie ahead before the Philippine Islands, and the people imprisoned on them, can be liberated. A series by Ken Burns. Part 10 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Winter 1944 to 1945. The Allies are unprepared for Hitler's counterattack in the Ardennes Forest of Belgium and Luxembourg. It is the biggest battle of the war on the Western Front, fought during the coldest winter in memory. By the time the Battle of the Bulge is over, Hitler's enormous gamble has ended in disaster and the Russians are approaching Berlin. Meanwhile, in the Santo Tomas Camp in the Philippines, thousands of internees await liberation. A series by Ken Burns. Part 11 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Winter to Spring 1945. On the island of Iwo Jima, the marines face 21,000 Japanese defenders who, without hope of reinforcement, have been ordered to kill as many Americans as possible before being killed themselves. Once the island is taken, Allied bombers set the cities of Japan ablaze, killing thousands and leaving millions homeless. In Europe, Americans are crossing the Rhine and driving into Germany, while the Russians are within 50 miles of Berlin. A series by Ken Burns. Part 12 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Spring 1945. In the Pacific, Americans fight on the island of Okinawa while kamikaze pilots wreak havoc on the fleet offshore. In Europe, allied forces rapidly push across Germany from the east and west, and American and British troops discover the true horrors of the Nazis' industrialised barbarism at Buchenwald, Dachau, Mauthausen and other concentration camps. Finally, on 8 May, with their country in ruins and their Fuhrer dead, the Germans surrender. A series by Ken Burns. Part 13 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: May to December 1945. In June, the battle on Okinawa ends yet Japan's rulers, despite the agony their people are enduring, resist unconditional surrender. On 6 August 1945, an American plane drops an atomic bomb on Hiroshima. Two days later, Russia declares war against Japan. A second atomic bomb is dropped on Nagasaki and, finally, Japan surrenders. In the following months, hundreds of thousands of American servicemen and women return home. A series by Ken Burns. Part 14 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: December 1941 to March 1942. The Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor in December 1941 thrusts the United States into the global cataclysm that will eventually touch every family on every street in every town in America. Within a few months, millions of young men have entered the armed forces and are beginning to train for war. A series by Ken Burns. Part 1 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: March 1942 to December 1942. With U-boats menacing the East Coast, and little good news from overseas, many worry that the United States is utterly unprepared to fight in a 'total war'. But after six months of gruelling combat on Guadalcanal, the Americans finally stop Japan's expansion in the Pacific. A series by Ken Burns. Part 2 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: January 1943 to June 1943. American troops land in North Africa and test themselves for the first time against the German and Italian armies, learning to set aside the notion that killing is a sin, and adopting the outlook that 'killing is a craft'. Back home, cities become booming 'war towns' overnight as nearly all manufacturing is converted to the war effort, and thousands of women become industrial workers. A series by Ken Burns. Part 3 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: July 1943 to December 1943. On daylight bombing missions, American airmen gamble with their lives against overwhelming odds to bring the war to the heart of Hitler's vast empire. Allied forces invade Sicily and then Italy but, as they grind their way towards Rome, the weather turns bad and the terrain grows more and more forbidding. Twisting mountain roads and blown bridges have to be negotiated while under constant German fire. A series by Ken Burns. Part 4 of 14.
